recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** has issued guidelines for political advertisements ahead of upcoming state assembly elections. The ECI stated that no political advertisement can be published in newspapers on polling day or a day prior unless pre-certified by the Media Certification and Monitoring Committee (MCMC).  **Individuals** and **political parties** must apply to the MCMC for certification, with applications due two days before proposed publication. The MCMC will ensure timely pre-certification and monitor for suspected paid news.

recent_articles.title: Congress petitions Election Commission to cancel Assam CM’s candidature over ‘undisclosed assets’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, the Chief Minister of Assam, is facing a petition from the **Assam Congress** to cancel his candidacy for the upcoming Assembly election. The petition alleges that he failed to disclose his wife's alleged offshore assets in his affidavit, violating the Representation of the People Act, 1951. A delegation led by former Chhattisgarh Chief Minister **Bhupesh Baghel** submitted the complaint to the Assam Chief Electoral Officer.  Sarma denies the allegations.

recent_articles.title: ‘Cocktail of Hindutva and welfarism’: How Modi’s BJP is wooing Assam voters | Elections News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Assam is using a mix of xenophobic anti-Muslim policies and financial aid schemes to retain power. The party's campaign emphasizes the welfare programs launched by Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, particularly the Orunodoi cash transfer scheme, which has been distributed to millions of women ahead of the election.  Critics argue that these schemes are aimed at influencing voters and consolidating support for the BJP. Opposition parties and analysts suggest that the BJP is using cash transfers as a tactic to secure votes, especially among female voters. The party's rhetoric targeting Bengali-speaking Muslims, including accusations of being "foreigners" and threats of eviction, has heightened anxieties within this community.  The BJP's hardline stance on immigration and its promise to crack down on "Love Jihad" have also been met with concern from Muslim groups.

recent_articles.title: Assam Election 2026: What BJP and Congress promise in their manifestos - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The upcoming Assam Legislative Assembly elections are scheduled for April 9, 2026, with the counting of votes taking place on May 4, 2026. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Congress are the main contenders in this election, promising various policies to address issues such as land rights, economic development, and social welfare.  **Nirmala Sitharaman**, Union Finance Minister, presented the BJP's "Sankalp Patra" which focuses on implementing a Uniform Civil Code, protecting land and heritage, and furthering its development agenda. **Rahul Gandhi**, Congress leader, released the party's "Raijor Istahar", or people's manifesto, promising Scheduled Tribe status for six communities, an Anti Corruption Commission, and a white paper on Assam finances.  The elections will involve around 2.50 crore registered voters across 31,486 polling stations.

recent_articles.title: Congress concocted allegations against my wife using false info from Pak social media group: Assam CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, Assam Chief Minister, accused the **Congress** of fabricating claims about his wife's multiple passports and Dubai properties to influence the upcoming elections. He alleged that these accusations originated from a Pakistani social media group and were part of a larger attempt by Pakistan to interfere in the polls.  Sarma stated that he has filed a complaint against **Pawan Khera**, a Congress spokesperson, for making false allegations.

recent_articles.title: ‘Some people are more native, but it’s a question of citizenship’: Hiren Gohain - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hiren Gohain**, a prominent Assam writer and activist, advocates for Opposition unity in the upcoming election.  He believes this alliance would be more beneficial to voters than individual parties. **Harekrishna Deka**, leader of the **Assam Nagorik Sanmilani**, a citizens' collective he founded, has been calling for judicial intervention against **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, Assam's Chief Minister, over alleged hate speeches.  The High Court hearing on these claims has been postponed to April 21st. Gohain also discusses the complexities of defining "indigenous Assamese" and the impact of the Citizenship (Amendment) Act on Assam's demographics. He believes that extremism does not bring about positive change and that violence will ultimately harm the people of Assam.

recent_articles.title: Why vocal about infiltration only in Assam: Manipur-based Naga group asks PM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **United Naga Council (UNC)**, representing Naga communities in Manipur, has urged **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** to address illegal immigration concerns beyond Assam. The council expressed concern over the perceived lack of action on this issue when visiting other northeastern states, particularly Manipur, where it highlights the impact on demographic balance and indigenous rights. The UNC called for immediate deportation of illegal immigrants, support for affected communities, and a mechanism to prevent future influx in Manipur.

recent_articles.title: Assam polls revive memory of journalist killed 35 years ago - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kamala Saikia**, a teacher-journalist killed by the **United Liberation Front of Asom (ULFA)** in 1991, is at the center of political controversy in Assam's upcoming election.  **Akhil Gogoi** of the Raijor Dal accuses his BJP rival, **Kushal Duwari**, of involvement in Saikia's death, while **Duwari** denies any involvement and points to the ULFA's admission of responsibility. The candidates are locked in a fierce battle for the Sibsagar seat, with other former ULFA members also vying for positions.

recent_articles.title: Time to bring youth back to sports from drugs: CM Revanth Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** expressed concern over youth disengagement from sports, emphasizing the need to redirect them towards constructive activities like football.  He presented the winning trophy to the **CISF team** at the 74th B.N. Mullik Memorial All India Police Football Championship held in Gachibowli Indoor Stadium.  The tournament saw participation from teams across the country, with the **CISF** men's team claiming victory and **Assam Rifles** winning the women's category. The event was attended by senior officials including **Cyberabad Commissioner M. Ramesh**, **Director General of Police B. Shivadhar Reddy**, and **Telangana Sports Minister Vakiti Srihari**.

recent_articles.title: Campaigning for BJP, Manipur CM woos Assam Manipuris - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yumnam Khemchand Singh**, Manipur Chief Minister, campaigned for the **BJP** in Assam's Cachar district on April 5th, 2026. He projected Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** as a protector of Manipur's boundary and **Himanta Biswa Sarma** as a friend to Manipuri people.  Singh urged voters to support the BJP-led government in Assam, highlighting the inclusion of Manipuri as an associate official language. The campaign saw the participation of seven Manipur BJP legislators and State BJP president A. Sharda Devi.

recent_articles.title: Congress alleges Sarma’s wife holds three passports, Dubai properties; Assam CM rejects claims - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leader Pawan Khera alleged that the wife of **Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma**, Riniki Bhuyan Sharma, possesses passports from three countries and owns properties in Dubai.  Sarma vehemently denied these claims, calling them "malicious, fabricated, and politically motivated lies." He vowed to take legal action against Khera and asserted that the allegations are baseless. **Home Minister Amit Shah** and **Election Commission of India** officials have been called upon to investigate the matter.

recent_articles.title: Assam Assembly polls: Like Zubeen Garg, Cong works to unite people, says Rahul Gandhi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Congress party**,  compared his party's philosophy to that of musician **Zubeen Garg**, who worked to unite Assam. He accused **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, the current Chief Minister of Assam, of being the "most corrupt CM in India" and promised legal action against him after the Congress forms a government. Gandhi also alleged that the BJP government led by Sarma is spreading hatred against people and communities.

recent_articles.title: Judicial infrastructure not optional but essential: CJI Surya Kant - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Justice of India Surya Kant** emphasized the importance of strengthening judicial infrastructure, stating that when the judiciary and executive align in purpose, the Constitution truly comes alive.  He commended **state governments across the political spectrum** for recognizing this necessity, having recently laid foundation stones for similar projects in various states. The **Telangana High Court** is set to receive a new 100-acre complex, with construction expected to be completed within two years.  The project includes residential buildings for judges and the Chief Justice, alongside other infrastructure.

recent_articles.title: From selfies to slogan: how Instagram is becoming India’s newest political battleground - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ankit Pandey** posted a video of men praying on the railway platform, sparking outrage and leading to increased political content consumption on **Instagram**.  Political parties are increasingly using short-form videos for their campaigns, leveraging the platform's algorithm to target specific demographics. The rise in political content has led to concerns about misinformation and disinformation, with some influencers even creating AI-generated content that can be harmful or misleading. While Instagram offers a convenient way for political actors to reach voters, its impact on electoral outcomes remains uncertain.

recent_articles.title: Assam Assembly election: Less than a week before polls, BJP shifts focuses to youth empowerment, floods - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** in Assam has shifted its election focus from infiltrators and identity politics to youth empowerment and flood mitigation. **Information Minister Pijush Hazarika**, seeking re-election, highlighted the government's achievements in job creation, skill development initiatives like the Chief Minister Flight program, and flood management efforts.  He emphasized a commitment to exceeding two lakh jobs in the next five years and investing over ₹18,000 crore in the Flood-Free Assam Mission. The party also acknowledged the concerns of Gen Z and Gen Alpha regarding the late singer **Zubeen Garg**, and pledged to address them as part of its new campaign strategy.

recent_articles.title: Assam town rides BJP’s development showcase - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Jursing Bordoloi**, an advisor to the **Tiwa king**, and local residents in Jagiroad, Assam are cautiously optimistic about the potential of a new semiconductor plant being developed by the **Tata Group**.  The project, approved in March 2024, is expected to create employment for over 26,000 people. While some residents hope the plant will revitalize the town's economy and provide more job opportunities than the previous paper mill, others remain skeptical about its long-term impact. **Pijush Hazarika**, the **Information Minister** of Assam, has touted the project as a major economic development for the state.

recent_articles.title: NGT stays Assam order deploying forest personnel for poll duty, flags biodiversity risks - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **National Green Tribunal (NGT)** has stayed an Assam government order directing the deployment of around 1,600 personnel from the **Assam Forest Protection Force (AFPF)** for election duties. The tribunal cited environmental concerns and invoked the precautionary principle, ordering the state to cease violating environmental laws.  The NGT issued notices to the respondents and scheduled a hearing for April 6th. This is reportedly the first time forest personnel have been requisitioned for election duty in Assam.

recent_articles.title: FCRA Amendment Bill an attack on religious freedom, social activism: T.N. CM Stalin in Nagercoil - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **M.K. Stalin**, the DMK president and Chief Minister, criticized the **Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA)** Amendment Bill, calling it a severe attack on religious freedom and humanitarian activities. He argued that the bill could harm India's global reputation and questioned the AIADMK's stance on the issue, accusing them of becoming subservient to the BJP.  Stalin also announced new promises for fishermen during his election campaign in Nagercoil.

recent_articles.title: Assembly Elections LIVE: Trinamool seeks removal of Bhabanipur RO, alleges proximity with BJP's Suvendu Adhikari - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Trinamool Congress (TMC)** filed a complaint with the West Bengal Chief Electoral Officer, demanding the removal of the Returning Officer for the Bhabanipur Assembly constituency due to alleged ties to **BJP candidate Suvendu Adhikari**.  The BJP released its list of candidates for the upcoming assembly elections in Tamil Nadu. The Congress announced candidates for 27 out of 28 constituencies allotted to it by the DMK. West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee accused **AIMIM** and **ISF** of instigating a gherao of judicial officers in Malda district, while Assam, Kerala, and Puducherry will hold elections on April 9th.

recent_articles.title: In poll-bound Assam, Adityanath stresses U.P. model of dealing with rioters - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, the **Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister**, addressed an election rally in Assam, comparing "rioters" and "infiltrators" to highlight his stance on law and order. He asserted that only the **BJP-led NDA** can prevent demographic change in Assam, claiming that the Congress has weakened the state's security and social fabric by encouraging infiltration and violence. Adityanath criticized the **Congress** and **AIUDF**, accusing them of working together to compromise Assam's culture and heritage. He promised a BJP-led government would ensure stability and crack down on illegal entrants, while also emphasizing development and cultural preservation.

recent_articles.title: Pakistan jibes become central to BJP’s Assam poll narrative - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, the Chief Minister of Assam, has criticized **Lurinjyoti Gogoi**, the AJP candidate for Guwahati Central constituency, for his alleged links to "anti-national" elements.  Sarma also attacked **Sujata Gurung Chowdhury**, Kunki Chowdhury's mother, for publicly supporting Sharjeel Imam and Umar Khalid, both accused in the 2020 Delhi riots case. The controversy has drawn attention to Pakistan as a topic of discussion in the Assam election. **Saadulla**, a former Prime Minister of Assam, is being used by the BJP to highlight alleged infiltration attempts into the state during his tenure.

recent_articles.title: TRS name open for use, says Kavitha as she plans her new party launch - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kalvakuntla Kavitha**, president of **Telangana Jagruthi**, stated that the **Bharat Rashtra Samiti (BRS)**, her father's party, is inactive and she intends to launch a new political party later this month.  She plans to focus on challenging the **Congress Party** in the upcoming elections and has not yet decided where she will contest. Kavitha expressed confidence in public support for women candidates and highlighted concerns over constituency reorganisation disparities across states.

recent_articles.title: Congress is politically incompetent and ideologically bankrupt, says D. Raja - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D. Raja**, general secretary of the **Communist Party of India**, criticized the Congress and **Rahul Gandhi** for short-sightedness, urging them to introspect.  He argued that the Left Democratic Front (LDF) is facing baseless allegations from the BJP and Congress while maintaining its commitment to social justice and equality. The LDF has been successful in Kerala on various fronts, including poverty reduction, healthcare, and education, according to **Raja**. He believes the people of Kerala will assess political parties based on their performance and vision for the future.

recent_articles.title: Cow, buffalo for each Assam tribal family, promises Amit Shah - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Amit Shah**, **Union Home Minister** and senior **BJP** leader, promised to give a cow and a buffalo to each tribal family in Assam if the party is re-elected for a third consecutive term. He also pledged to establish large dairies in every district and highlighted the BJP's commitment to indigenous people through increased funding for their welfare.  Shah attributed the rise in budget allocation for indigenous peoples to Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**, while emphasizing that the BJP has been proactive in addressing tribal concerns, including clashes between infiltrators and local tribes. He also promised to introduce a Uniform Civil Code (UCC) to curb polygamy and population growth among infiltrators.

recent_articles.title: Government called ‘special session’ for political mileage in West Bengal, Tamil Nadu polls; it is MCC violation: Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Congress** alleges that the government is calling a special session to pass bills related to amending the women's quota law and delimitation in order to gain political mileage ahead of state elections in West Bengal and Tamil Nadu. The party claims this move violates the model code of conduct, as the government has been "sleeping" on the issue for 30 months since the passage of the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, 2023.  The **Congress** general secretary in-charge communications, Jairam Ramesh, argues that the proposed bill would disproportionately benefit certain states at the expense of others and calls for an all-party meeting after April 29th before any action is taken. The government has not officially responded to these allegations but maintains it has the right to decide on the timing of legislation.
